title: The User Frontend – Membership, User Registration, User Profile, User Directory & Content Restriction with Frontend…
description: The User Frontend WordPress plugin up to version 4.3.13 is vulnerable to reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) via the 'field_attr[required]' parameter. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary scripts. The nonce check intended to protect the AJAX action is ineffective because the nonce value is publicly accessible to anonymous visitors, enabling attackers to harvest it and bypass protections.
